neighbours.label: the 'to'/'for' right after 'too + adjective' in the excess-degree construction (too big to fit, too small for); weaker for 'ADJ enough to'; plain 'to', 'too' meaning 'also' and 'very ADJ' stay quiet
fire: The ladder was too short to reach the roof.
The coffee was too bitter to drink.
My grandmother is too frail to travel alone.
The print was too small to read without glasses.
That car is too expensive for a student.
It was too dark to see the path.
There were too many boxes to fit in the van.
The river was too wide to swim across.
quiet: The ladder was short and easy to carry to the roof.
The coffee was bitter but nice to drink.
My grandmother is frail and eager to travel alone.
The print was very small to read without glasses.
That car is very expensive for a student.
It was hard to see the path in the dark.
There were many boxes to fit in the van.
The river was wide but easy to swim across.
